audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics are attributed to the wrong ability, and one instruction describes something that cannot happen. The content layer repeatedly puts '% max-HP true damage' on Tactical Sweep's outer half, and spikes[1] tells you to 'bait her Hookshot onto a minion so she can't wall-dash the stun onto you'. The decisive passive interaction is stated nowhere.
audit.why: Riot's text for Tactical Sweep is 'Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille' — no true damage. The true damage sits on Precision Protocol, whose recast does 'significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks'. Hookshot is 'Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing' — it attaches to terrain, not to minions, so a minion cannot bait it; standing away from walls is what denies it. And Adaptive Defenses gives her 'a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type' — against Galio that shield is always a magic shield, formed by autoing you.
audit.corrected: True damage moved to the Precision Protocol recast, the heal left on Tactical Sweep, the minion-bait replaced with the terrain rule, and Adaptive Defenses written into the early and mid text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Camille 'him' and 'his' in tradeBad, dontsFull, report[9], report[10] and the itemization line; report[2] gives no read on the chart at all.

audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every edited line and the chart summary rewritten to name the split.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why calls Stormsurge/Riftmaker your spike on a stage the chart gives Camille, phases[4].why ends with 'Reassess his ultimate too', and no cooldowns appear anywhere.
audit.why: Hookshot 16s at rank 1 over 800 range, Tactical Sweep 15s at 610, The Hextech Ultimatum 140s at rank 1 and only 475 range. Those numbers turn 'respect her engage' into a countable window.
audit.corrected: Every stage line now names the ability and the number that owns it.

edits.before: The 1v1 only tilts harder to her here — Camille's true damage scales past any armor or HP you stack, and The Hextech Ultimatum can trap you alone where no amount of tankiness saves you, so your AP-tank value plateaus while her kit keeps climbing. Stop thinking duel and think teamfight: your worth is the Hero's Entrance global engage and the Shield of Durand taunt that peels her off your carries. Never get caught in her R in a side lane. Group, use Hero's Entrance to start fights on your terms, and let your team punish her after your taunt eats her commit.
